result.title: Spatial Context or Memory? Sizing the Inputs of Neural Surrogates for Partially Observed Fields
result.summary: Neural surrogates that forecast a physical field from sparse, noisy sensors read a window of nearby sensors and a history of past snapshots. Practitioners choose both by comparing fitted models with each other. Such comparisons cannot tell a model's shortfall from missing information. We measure the trade-off between window and history against the Bayes-optimal error of the same readings. An exact Gaussian analysis shows that noisy or sparse observation of a field with local dynamics makes the optimal forecast read distant sensors only through spatial correlation. On a forced linear field with a known optimum, trained models that read only the window come within 1% of it. We then train such models on viscous Burgers flow and the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, with every deciding comparison fixed before any test evaluation. In every field except KS, eight snapshots remove a smaller fraction of the one-snapshot error as the lead time, the number of steps to the forecast target, grows. In KS, for windows up to one correlation length, they remove a larger fraction. This lead-time inversion persists across sensor densities, three architectures and a two-dimensional domain. It shrinks as damping lowers the Lyapunov exponent. Damping also removes the linear instability of KS. We therefore tie the inversion to instability and leave chaos and linear amplification unseparated. For surrogate design the results give two rules. Size the window in correlation lengths of the field. Split a fixed input budget between window and history for the lead time the model will serve, because the best split moves toward wider windows as the lead time grows. In Burgers flow the split chosen at lead time one ends with 13.5 times the best error at lead time eight.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究稀疏含噪传感器下神经场代理应读多宽的空间窗口与多长的历史快照，先用精确高斯分析给出贝叶斯最优误差作为参照，再在 Burgers 流与 KS 方程上以预先固定的比较训练模型，得到「窗口按相关长度取尺、输入预算按预测提前期分配」的设计规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用贝叶斯最优误差校准输入需求、并把空间上下文与历史记忆的贡献分开量化的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉支撑集宽度、缓存/历史长度及证据贡献分配的度量提供可核查的思路，但领域相去较远，需人工判断可迁移性。
